filterSummary: Successfully matched highly relevant videos for Functional vs. Nonfunctional Requirements in both languages. However, the candidate pool for the other four topics consisted entirely of distractors (e.g., physics dynamics instead of system dynamics, civil architecture instead of software architecture, and design thinking instead of systems thinking), resulting in those slots being left empty due to strict relevance gating.

coverage.note: All candidates cover rigid body mechanics (physics) rather than system dynamics modeling - relevance gate.
Candidates cover general systems theory or control systems, lacking focus on system dynamics modeling and feedback loops - relevance gate.
Candidate focuses on enterprise network architecture (Cisco) rather than enterprise architecture frameworks like TOGAF - relevance gate.
Candidate explains software frameworks vs libraries, not enterprise architecture frameworks - relevance gate.
Candidates cover microprocessor system design, not the software engineering concepts of systems architecting vs detailed design - relevance gate.
Candidates discuss civil architecture or data analysis, not software systems architecting - relevance gate.
No candidates available for systems thinking.
Candidates cover design thinking, critical thinking, and fast/slow thinking, but none cover systems thinking - relevance gate.
